name: Kisaragi Soushichi
source:
The protagonist of Ayakashibito. His former name before he escaped from the island facility is Takebe Ryouichi.
He's a Jinyou who cries when he is sad, and cries when he is really happy. He can make good decisions on the fly, and thus makes good use of his power: [spoiler]ability to communicate with metals[/spoiler]. Pretty mature in terms of attitude towards life, and values the importance of everyday life.

[spoiler]He is a Relative of a Human made Youkai a Tsukumogami.[/spoiler]

[Edited from a really spoiler-filled [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/12/12/chronobelt-review]Chrono Belt review[/url] by Warum]
